status: Review completed; concrete findings fixed and independently checked. Browser integration/playthrough remains unverified.

findings.issue: Menu could dispatch on-frame scripts during area loading
findings.resolution: menu now rejects transitioning before field priority dispatch

findings.issue: Border trainer could leave browser ownership/context stale
findings.resolution: Synchronize world.owner header first, then dispatch current frame/trainer priority and recompute coordinates. Native seamless overlay ordering was not proved by review; this is the browser context correction.

findings.issue: Player Surf eligibility incorrectly blocked native NPC sight across water
findings.resolution: Adapter uses collision attribute bit15 plus native directional/height/occupancy and furniture, never player HM eligibility. Clear-water and blocked-water regression fixtures pass.

findings.issue: Missing native double partner threw before retry latch, preventing walking away
findings.resolution: Structured MissingTrainerPartner is caught, reported inside the same source-action runScript boundary as Unsupported, and latched once per player tile. Location observation also clears stale attempts after leaving and returning.

findings.issue: Moving actors occupied only current coordinates
findings.resolution: Native current+previous NPC tile/floor occupancy and follower previous positions retained during tween and cleared after drain. Autonomous NPC movement/large follower extra footprint remains outside this change.

findings.issue: Trainer constant lookup differed from VM
findings.resolution: Both now resolve map constants before global constants.

independentFollowupReview: Recovery integration owner read current transition guard, owner synchronization, missing-partner admission/latch, path drain and raw collision adapter; no additional concrete defect reported. Source-action busy/recovery guards and followerPrevious reset must survive merge.
limitations: Double/multi battle engine remains explicitly unsupported before combat.
Hidden movement51-54 reveal animation remains explicitly unsupported.
Incoming trainer phone scheduling and general trainer callers remain unsupported.
Recovery, virtual camera and Violet Gym integrations are owned by other isolated branches; natural merged-runtime verification remains necessary.
